description: This file defines the main API endpoints for a notes backend application using FastAPI. It handles CRUD operations for notes and tags, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and searching/filtering notes and tags. It also configures application settings, middleware, and error handling.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a new note.

classes.name: NoteListOut
classes.description: Output model for listing multiple notes.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Output model for a single note.

classes.name: TagCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new tag.

classes.name: TagOut
classes.description: Output model for a single tag.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Handles logic related to notes operations such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: TagsFlow
classes.description: Handles logic related to tags operations such as listing, creating, renaming, and deleting tags.
